Here is a detailed description of the video segment:

The video opens with a gray screen displaying a logo that reads, "the environment NEXUS your digital ecosystem". A website address, "www.iiea.com/environmentnexus" and the hashtag "#environex", appear below the logo. The text fades and a question appears: "What is the Fund for European Aid to the Most Deprived?". Then, a woman named Emer Costello, Member of the European Parliament, is seen from the chest up against a gray background. She has short brown hair and wears glasses and a white blazer. She is speaking directly to the camera, explaining that the fund is a new EU fund that provides food and material assistance to vulnerable citizens across the European Union. She emphasizes the high number of people at risk of poverty in Europe and expresses the fund’s purpose as a practical expression of EU solidarity. The video then transitions back to the gray screen, with the question "How is it different from the previous fund?" displayed in orange and white.
